mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_sessions (user_id, title, is_pinned) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, COALESCE(#{isPinned}, FALSE))
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id as userId, title, COALESCE(is_pinned, FALSE) as isPinned, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM chat_sessions WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}

SELECT id, user_id as userId, title, COALESCE(is_pinned, FALSE) as isPinned, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM chat_sessions WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY is_pinned DESC, updated_at DESC, created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_sessions SET title = #{title}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE chat_sessions SET is_pinned = NOT COALESCE(is_pinned, FALSE), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO chat_session_knowledge_bases (session_id, knowledge_base_id) VALUES
(#{sessionId}, #{kbId})
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT knowledge_base_id FROM chat_session_knowledge_bases WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY knowledge_base_id ASC

SELECT kb.id, kb.name, kb.original_filename as originalFilename, kb.file_size as fileSize, kb.content_type as contentType, kb.file_hash as fileHash, kb.category, kb.vector_status as vectorStatus, kb.vector_error as vectorError, kb.chunk_count as chunkCount, kb.uploaded_at as uploadedAt, kb.updated_at as updatedAt FROM knowledge_bases kb INNER JOIN chat_session_knowledge_bases skb ON kb.id = skb.knowledge_base_id WHERE skb.session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY kb.id ASC
